Scenario: Renovate validates through its pinned download without a global installation

g.text: Given a project has an invalid configuration and no installed Renovate
The generated project has an invalid option and a pinned Renovate version. The CodeceptJS
runner has no global Renovate installation.
When the pinned Renovate download rejects the invalid option
The project's actual task downloads the pinned release through npx. Renovate rejects the
Then correcting the configuration passes the same Renovate task
Removing the invalid option makes the same task pass. Validation remains mandatory.
And the Renovate download fallback uses the framework version for
On a machine without an installed tool, both tasks resolve the same framework-pinned
Renovate release. The test reads the commands Go Task would execute.
